specs.label: Command line: volume_panel <name>
specs.note: The one volume affordance reachable in local mode. cmd.volume_panel is registered by the in-browser engine (packages/engine-ts/src/cmd/extras.ts:802) to raise ImportError: pymol.Qt, exactly as Open-Source PyMOL does, because there is no pymol.Qt. Typing it at the prompt must surface that as feedback and NOT crash the page or open a React window (the browser editor is a separate surface reached via the bridge marker / popup-leaf hook, not this cmd). This proves the command routes to the engine and fails cleanly.

specs.label: Popup-menu leaf: A ▸ volume ▸ panel opens the React editor
specs.note: menuBridge.installVolumeMenuBridge registers a global leaf hook so that a PyMOL pop-up row whose command is cmd.volume_panel('name') is claimed client-side and opens the React editor with zero round trip (features/pymol-menu/leafHooks.ts + PopupMenu.tsx dispatchLeaf). BLOCKED locally: the only live pymolMenu producer is the Mouse-Config popup (features/mouse/ButModeBlock.tsx); no viewport-picking popup emits the volume `panel` leaf in local mode, and the object-panel C-menu dispatches via session.run (engine ImportError) rather than dispatchLeaf. Recorded for inventory; needs a picking-driven object popup to drive.

specs.label: Bridge marker TENMOL_VOLUME panel <name> opens the editor
specs.note: The engine-side shim (packages/bridge/tenmol_bridge/panels/volume.py) rebinds cmd.volume_panel to record the request and print one tagged feedback line; menuBridge parses it and calls openVolumeWindow, mounting the overlay slot. This is the route that works from the prompt, a .pml script, a plugin, and the object panel. BLOCKED: requires a running PyMOL bridge; there is no bridge in the local audit stack.

specs.label: preset ▸ named-ramp dropdown
specs.note: The <select data-volume-preset> offers PyMOL's named volume ramps read live (cmd.tenmol_volume.ramps, else menu.vol_color, else the built-in five). Choosing one calls applyPreset (cmd.volume_color(name, '<ramp>')) then reload(), recolouring the ramp canvas. BLOCKED: the panel only opens under a bridge; the preset list itself is also a live bridge read.

specs.label: Reload button
specs.note: data-volume-reload re-reads the ramp (cmd.volume_color getter), the preset list, and the histogram, and updates the .volpanel__status line. BLOCKED: needs an open panel (bridge) and the histogram/getter bridge calls.

specs.label: preset-source indicator (built-in list / live)
specs.note: data-volume-preset-source shows which of the three tiers answered the named-ramp read (tenmol_volume.ramps | menu.vol_color | constant) with a title tooltip and a data-volume-preset-extra count. A display affordance surfacing otherwise-invisible state. BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge.

specs.label: tracking / untracked indicator
specs.note: data-volume-watch reports whether the engine is delivering volume_ramp_changed events for this object (cmd.tenmol_volume.watch) and how many outside reloads have arrived (data-volume-remote). BLOCKED: the subscription and the panel both require a bridge.

specs.label: N stops counter
specs.note: data-volume-count shows the number of ramp points currently loaded and updates as points are added/removed. BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge.

specs.label: Get colors as script button
specs.note: data-volume-script opens a TextDialog whose body is the cmd.volume_ramp_new(...) snippet for the current ramp (ramp.colorsAsScript). BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge. Once open the dialog itself is pure client-side.

specs.label: Close the Get-colors-as-script dialog
specs.note: The script TextDialog's Close button dismisses it (onClose -> modal none). BLOCKED: requires the open panel and dialog.

specs.label: Reset Data Range button
specs.note: data-volume-reset restores vmin/vmax to the original histogram range and pushes the ramp unconditionally (cmd.volume_color, _guiupdate:0), redrawing the axes. BLOCKED: needs the open panel (bridge).

specs.label: Help button
specs.note: data-volume-help opens a TextDialog containing the VOLUME PANEL HELP text (the L/M/R mouse legend). BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge; the dialog is client-side once shown.

specs.label: Close the Help dialog
specs.note: The Help TextDialog's Close button dismisses it. BLOCKED: requires the open panel and dialog.

specs.label: Update volume colors in real-time checkbox
specs.note: data-volume-realtime gates whether drags and colour-dialog previews push to the engine live (checked by default). Toggling it flips the checkbox state; add/remove/wheel/release still push regardless. BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge.

specs.label: Canvas L-click on empty plot: add a ramp point
specs.note: A plain left-click on empty plot area inserts one colour point (ramp.addPoint), advances the colour cycle, pushes, and bumps the stop counter. BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge. Limitation: the driver's click hits the canvas centre; exact plot coordinates are not addressable, so which point lands where is not deterministic.

specs.label: Canvas CTRL+L-click on empty plot: add 3 points (isosurface)
specs.note: Ctrl+left-click on empty plot inserts the clicked point plus two zero-alpha points at -10/+10 px (isosurface preset). BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge. Limitation: the driver cannot issue a modifier-held click at a chosen canvas coordinate; recorded for inventory.

specs.label: Canvas L-click on a point: open colour picker (single)
specs.note: Left-click on an existing point (no drag) opens the .volpanel__picker colour editor for that one stop. BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge. Limitation: hitting a specific point requires its pixel coordinate, which the coordinate-blind driver cannot target.

specs.label: Canvas CTRL+L-click on a point: colour picker (triple)
specs.note: Ctrl+left-click on a point opens the picker in triple mode (recolours the point and both neighbours; label shows '(+neighbours)'). BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge. Limitation: modifier-held click at a point coordinate is not drivable.

specs.label: Canvas R-click on a point: edit data value
specs.note: Right-click on a point (no modifier or ctrl) opens a NumberPrompt for the point's data value, clamped to its neighbours. BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge. Limitation: the driver cannot issue a right-button click at a chosen canvas coordinate.

specs.label: Canvas SHIFT+R-click on a point: edit opacity
specs.note: Shift+right-click on a point opens a NumberPrompt for the point's alpha (0..1). BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge. Limitation: modifier+right-button click at a point coordinate is not drivable.

specs.label: Canvas M-click on a point: remove point
specs.note: Middle-click on a point removes it (ramp.removePoints) and pushes. BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge. Limitation: middle-button click at a point coordinate is not drivable.

specs.label: Canvas SHIFT+L-click on a point: remove point
specs.note: Shift+left-click on a point removes it (alternative to middle-click). BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge. Limitation: modifier-held click at a point coordinate is not drivable.

specs.label: Canvas CTRL+M-click on a point: remove 3 points
specs.note: Ctrl+middle-click removes the point plus its two neighbours (removePoints triple). BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge. Limitation: modifier+middle-button click at a point coordinate is not drivable.

specs.label: Canvas CTRL+SHIFT+L-click on a point: remove 3 points
specs.note: Ctrl+shift+left-click removes the point plus its two neighbours (alternative to ctrl+middle). BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge. Limitation: two-modifier click at a point coordinate is not drivable.

specs.label: Canvas L-drag a point: move it (value + alpha)
specs.note: Left-drag on a point moves it in both axes, clamped to its neighbours, with a live value/alpha tooltip; pushes when real-time is on. BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge. Limitation: the driver has no drag primitive across canvas coordinates.

specs.label: Canvas CTRL+L-drag a point: move 3 points (horizontal)
specs.note: Ctrl+left-drag moves the point and both neighbours together, horizontally only (alpha frozen). BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge. Limitation: no modifier-drag primitive on the canvas.

specs.label: Canvas R-drag a point: move along one axis only
specs.note: Right-drag latches to the axis of the first movement (x if |dx|>|dy| else y) and moves only along it for the rest of the gesture. BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge. Limitation: no right-button drag primitive on the canvas.

specs.label: Canvas CTRL+R-drag on empty plot: zoom in (band)
specs.note: Ctrl+right-drag paints a translucent selection band and, on release, sets vmin/vmax to the dragged data range (zoom in). BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge. Limitation: no modifier+right-button drag primitive on the canvas.

specs.label: Canvas wheel over plot: scale every alpha
specs.note: A wheel notch over the plot area scales every point's alpha by (1 - delta) and pushes, regardless of the real-time checkbox (non-passive wheel listener, preventDefault). BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge. Limitation: the driver has no wheel primitive.

specs.label: Canvas wheel over the vmin box: nudge minimum data value
specs.note: A wheel notch over the painted vmin value box nudges vmin by range*delta (view-only, never pushes). BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge. Limitation: no wheel primitive and the box is a painted canvas rect, not a DOM node.

specs.label: Canvas wheel over the vmax box: nudge maximum data value
specs.note: A wheel notch over the painted vmax value box nudges vmax by range*delta (view-only, never pushes). BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge. Limitation: no wheel primitive and the box is a painted canvas rect.

specs.label: Canvas wheel over the amax box: nudge maximum alpha
specs.note: A wheel notch over the painted amax value box multiplies amax by (1 + delta), clamped 0..1 (view-only, never pushes), rescaling the alpha axis. BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge. Limitation: no wheel primitive and the box is a painted canvas rect.

specs.label: Canvas L-click the vmin box: Minimum Data Value prompt
specs.note: Left-click on the painted vmin value box opens a NumberPrompt titled 'Minimum Data Value' (view-only; never pushes). BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge. Limitation: the box is a painted canvas rect at a coordinate the driver cannot target.

specs.label: Canvas L-click the vmax box: Maximum Data Value prompt
specs.note: Left-click on the painted vmax value box opens a NumberPrompt titled 'Maximum Data Value' (view-only). BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge. Limitation: painted canvas rect, coordinate not addressable by the driver.

specs.label: Canvas L-click the amax box: Maximum Alpha Value prompt
specs.note: Left-click on the painted amax value box opens a NumberPrompt titled 'Maximum Alpha Value' (0..1, view-only). BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge. Limitation: painted canvas rect, coordinate not addressable by the driver.

specs.label: Canvas hover a point: enlarge the dot
specs.note: Moving the pointer (no button) over a point redraws it at DOT_RADIUS+2 as a hover cue. BLOCKED: panel opens only under a bridge. Limitation: hovering a specific point needs its pixel coordinate; the hover lands at the canvas centre.

specs.label: Colour picker: change colour (live preview)
specs.note: The .volpanel__picker <input type=color data-volume-color> onChange recolours the point(s) and pushes live when real-time is on. BLOCKED: reaching the picker needs an open panel (bridge) and a point-click that the coordinate-blind driver cannot perform.

specs.label: Colour picker: OK
specs.note: data-volume-color-ok pushes the current colour and closes the picker. BLOCKED: reaching the picker needs an open panel (bridge) and a point-click the driver cannot target.

specs.label: Colour picker: Cancel
specs.note: data-volume-color-cancel restores the original colour, re-pushes it, and closes the picker. BLOCKED: reaching the picker needs an open panel (bridge) and a point-click the driver cannot target.

specs.label: Number prompt: type a value
specs.note: The NumberPrompt .dlgmodal__input accepts a numeric value for a point's value/alpha or a value box. BLOCKED: reaching a prompt needs an open panel (bridge) plus a point/box click the coordinate-blind driver cannot target.

specs.label: Number prompt: accept
specs.note: The NumberPrompt data-accept button applies the typed value (to the point value/alpha, or the vmin/vmax/amax view box) and closes the modal. BLOCKED: reaching a prompt needs an open panel (bridge) plus a point/box click the driver cannot target.

specs.label: Editor window title bar
specs.note: The DialogWindow chrome shows '<name> - Volume Color Map Editor' in .dlgwin__label. BLOCKED: the window mounts only when a volume editor is opened via the bridge.

specs.label: Editor window shade/restore button
specs.note: The DialogWindow title-bar shade button (title='shade'/'restore') collapses and restores the editor body. BLOCKED: the window mounts only via the bridge. Hosting chrome belongs to the dialogs feature; recorded here because it acts on the volume window.

specs.label: Editor window close button
specs.note: The DialogWindow close button (data-close) closes the volume editor window and unwatches the object (cmd.tenmol_volume.unwatch). BLOCKED: the window mounts only via the bridge.
